app_info.subtitle: Check domain availability
app_info.description: Check whether an exact domain name is available to register, check several at once, and suggest available names for a brand or idea. Uses live public registration data; never guesses.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads public registration status; changes nothing locally or remotely.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries live public RDAP registration infrastructure on the open internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: An availability lookup cannot delete, overwrite, charge, or irreversibly change anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Batch lookup only reads public registration status for each name.
justifications.open_world_justification: Each lookup queries live public RDAP infrastructure on the open internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Availability lookups have no side effects individually or in batch.

justifications.read_only_justification: Suggestion generation and availability filtering only read public data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Candidate availability is verified against live public RDAP infrastructure.

positive_test_cases.expected_output: Available/taken verdict for pogtown.com with validity confirmation.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Check pog.pet and pog.town for me.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Per-domain verdicts for both names in input order.

positive_test_cases.prompt: I like Pogtown. Give me ten strong available .com alternatives.
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Up to 5-10 available suggestions; taken names excluded, unknowns marked unknown.

positive_test_cases.prompt: Which of these is free: alpha.io, alpha.co, alpha.dev?
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Per-domain verdicts identifying the free ones.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Why is .com usually preferred for startups?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not trigger the plugin; answer as general information.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Brainstorm funny names for a dog show.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Do not trigger the plugin; pure ideation with no availability request.
